This story is the first day I realized fat people were useless sacks of shit.

I was a photographer for about 10 years and the studio I rented was this HUGE open room. It was 40x40 with 10 foot ceilings. I talked my idea to friends and family and after only a few days I found out that our local weight watchers chapter wanted a new space. They were paying $500 a month for a single meeting at another place so they were hoping to save some money. I reach out to them, offer them my place for $200 and they went insane. They said they'd take it, I said, great, and we scheduled a time to meet to look it over, and finalize everything.

This is where it gets good. We meet and they look at the space, they love it. I say, "Well, it's out front, it's the place where your car is."

They say, "There are only 9 spots, where are the rest of our people going to park?"

I think for a second and say, "Well this is a mixed zoned area, there are houses, business, churches, and I actually know a business owner 1 street over, he will absolutely let you park in his lot.
